required_conditions_i18n.en: Judged by the V2 contract conditions (draft/provisional, uncalibrated).
required_conditions_i18n.ja: V2契約の条件に従う（draft/provisional、未校正）。

boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 貓空樟樹步道沿線茶園與台北南郊丘陵景觀（台北旅遊網官方貓空農村小旅行；OSM footway 節點；海拔誠實留空）；清單主題的油桐花/菊花季窗查無本站可繫結的權威季節資料源，誠實不建時間窗契約——本契約為茶園步道主體；與既有 tw-132 二格山觀景台（3.52km）題材錯位——本點為茶園步道景觀。
boosters_i18n.en: Tea terraces and southern-Taipei hillside views along the Maokong Zhangshu trail (Taipei travel official Maokong farm-village page; OSM footway node). The list's tung-blossom/chrysanthemum windows have no authoritative seasonal source we can bind, so no time-window contract - honestly. Disjoint from tw-132 Ergeshan's basin night-view platform 3.52 km away.
boosters_i18n.ja: 猫空・樟樹歩道沿いの茶園と台北南郊の丘（台北旅遊網公式）。油桐・菊の季節窓は権威源がなく誠実に不構築。二格山とは題材が別。

penalties_i18n.zh-TW: 惡劣天候、能見度差、營運/季節窗外
penalties_i18n.en: Severe weather, poor visibility, outside operating/season window.
penalties_i18n.ja: 悪天候、視程不良、営業・季節窓外。
